name: gizmosql
description: Query your GizmoSQL (Arrow Flight SQL / DuckDB) server from Claude.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to a GizmoSQL server over Arrow Flight SQL using the official @gizmodata/gizmosql-client and the native GizmoSQL ADBC driver (bundled for macOS, Windows x64 and Linux).

Tools: list catalogs, schemas and tables; describe a table (columns, types, constraints, estimated rows); run parameterised SQL queries with row caps and timeouts; explain a query; server info. Writes are disabled unless you enable them. A `gizmosql://schema/{catalog}/{schema}/{table}` resource returns table DDL.

Up to three GizmoSQL servers can be configured; every tool takes an optional connection argument and use_connection switches the default.

The server runs on your machine and connects directly to the GizmoSQL host you configure (VPN / private networks work). Credentials are stored in your OS keychain by Claude Desktop and never appear in tool output or errors.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the configured GizmoSQL connections and which one is current (no credentials).

tools.name: use_connection
tools.description: Make a named connection the default for subsequent tool calls.

tools.name: list_catalogs
tools.description: List the catalogs (attached databases) visible to the connected user.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List schemas, optionally filtered to one catalog.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List tables and views (with type), optionally filtered by catalog, schema and a LIKE pattern.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Columns, types, nullability, constraints and estimated row count for a table or view.

tools.name: use_schema
tools.description: Set the session's default catalog and/or schema (DuckDB USE) for unqualified table names.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Run a SQL query (DuckDB dialect) with optional bound parameters; returns a row-capped Markdown table plus JSON.

tools.name: explain_query
tools.description: Return DuckDB's EXPLAIN plan for a query without executing it.

tools.name: execute_statement
tools.description: Execute a DML/DDL statement and return the affected-row count (only available when writes are enabled).

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: GizmoSQL/DuckDB versions, redacted connection details, effective limits and the extension version.

tools.name: login_sso
tools.description: Sign in via the server's OAuth/SSO provider in your browser (only available when SSO is enabled).

connection_name.title: Connection name
connection_name.description: Name for this (primary) connection, used with the connection argument of tools. Default: default.

host.title: GizmoSQL host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the GizmoSQL server (reachable from this machine, e.g. over your VPN).

default_catalog.title: Default catalog
default_catalog.description: Optional catalog (database) to USE at the start of each session. Leave blank for the server default.

default_schema.title: Default schema
default_schema.description: Optional schema to USE at the start of each session. Leave blank for the server default.

port.title: Port
port.description: Flight SQL port of the GizmoSQL server.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for basic authentication. For a GizmoSQL JWT/SSO token, enter the username "token" and paste the JWT as the password. A read-only role is recommended.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for basic authentication (or the JWT when the username is "token").

plaintext.title: Plaintext (no TLS)
plaintext.description: Connect without TLS. Only for development servers started without TLS.

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Enable INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL via the execute_statement tool. Keep off unless you need it; the database user's privileges remain the real security boundary.

max_rows.title: Maximum rows per query
max_rows.description: Upper bound on rows returned by run_query.

query_timeout_seconds.title: Query timeout (seconds)
query_timeout_seconds.description: Queries running longer than this are cancelled (0 disables the timeout).

oauth_port.title: OAuth/SSO port
oauth_port.description: HTTP port of the server's OAuth endpoint (only used by SSO sign-in).

enable_sso.title: Enable SSO sign-in tool
enable_sso.description: Adds a login_sso tool that signs in through the server's OAuth/SSO identity provider in your browser (leave username/password/token blank).

connection2_name.title: Connection 2: name
connection2_name.description: Optional name for an additional GizmoSQL server (default server2). Leave the host blank to disable this slot.

connection2_host.title: Connection 2: host
connection2_host.description: Hostname or IP of the additional server. Blank disables this connection.

connection2_username.title: Connection 2: username
connection2_username.description: Username for basic authentication (use "token" with a JWT as the password).

connection2_password.title: Connection 2: password
connection2_password.description: Password for basic authentication (or the JWT when the username is "token").

connection2_default_catalog.title: Connection 2: default catalog
connection2_default_catalog.description: Optional catalog to USE at session start.

connection2_default_schema.title: Connection 2: default schema
connection2_default_schema.description: Optional schema to USE at session start.

connection3_name.title: Connection 3: name
connection3_name.description: Optional name for an additional GizmoSQL server (default server3). Leave the host blank to disable this slot.

connection3_host.title: Connection 3: host
connection3_host.description: Hostname or IP of the additional server. Blank disables this connection.

connection3_username.title: Connection 3: username
connection3_username.description: Username for basic authentication (use "token" with a JWT as the password).

connection3_password.title: Connection 3: password
connection3_password.description: Password for basic authentication (or the JWT when the username is "token").

connection3_default_catalog.title: Connection 3: default catalog
connection3_default_catalog.description: Optional catalog to USE at session start.

connection3_default_schema.title: Connection 3: default schema
connection3_default_schema.description: Optional schema to USE at session start.
